caption: With the app embed switched on, a Notify me button appeared under Sold out on our out of stock test product. We did not save the theme. Only other app names show in the list.
Clicking Notify me opened a form for e-mail or SMS. We used a made up test address. After the signup the popup closed without a visible confirmation. The store name is hidden.

On our development store the app offered Standard, Rocket and Notify Me Plus, not the Lite, Kickstart and Starter plans in our dossier. The early bird banner still said until November 15 on 17 November. The store name is hidden.
Monthly limits per plan: Standard covers 1,500 notifications and pauses at the limit, extra preorders cost $0.15 each, and SMS costs $0.03 in the US and Canada. The store name is hidden.
Choosing Standard yearly showed $319.26 a year with a 7-day trial. Approve on Shopify then opened no approval screen, so we never saw the final charge. The store name is hidden.
